name: risetime
expr: [R,LT,UT,LL,UL] = risetime(x,4); r1=double(R); r2=double(LT); r3=double(UT); r4=double(LL); r5=double(UL);
comment: Sig: [R,LT,UT,LL,UL]=risetime(x,fs). Sharp single-sample edge: R=0.198 (the 10% and 90% levels both cross in one interval — was 0.224 before the findTransitions fix). LT/UT = lower/upper crossing times; LL/UL = reference levels. Fixes bugs/signal/risetime-falltime-outputs.md (value + outputs). vs MATLAB R2025b.
